segments.contextBefore: By changing the technique used to form the fractional parts of the control vector, you change the interpolation between the values in the source vector.

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let values: [Float] = [50, 90, 55, 10, 40, 85, 65, 15, 30, 80] let denominator = 1024 / Float(values.count - 1) let tau = Float.pi * 2 let controlVector: [Float] = (0 ..< 1024).map { let x = modf(Float($0) / denominator) return x.0 + (tanh((x.1 - 0.5) * tau) * 0.5) + 0.5 } let result = vDSP.linearInterpolate(elementsOf: values, using: controlVector) ```
